result.title: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
result.summary: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对 stable port-Hamiltonian 神经网络只能表示单一吸引子（全局 Lyapunov 函数仅一个全局极小）的限制，将 Hamiltonian 参数化为由输入凸网络生成的 Bregman 散度乘积，从而支持多个渐近稳定平衡点，并给出局部 Lyapunov 稳定性等理论结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是让内部状态函数具备多稳定平衡点的能量景观，这可能启发 LVR 中对多假设 latent 状态、迭代更新稳定性与收敛/停止判据的表述，但属远领域线索，需核查与多模态推理的关联。
